notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.3.0
notes.notes:
Some users encountered some errors at launch with the last version
we tried a first patch for this 
with this patch the software size is reduced by 200mo and some dll are removed

notes.title: 1.0.2.2 patch
notes.notes:
This patch fixes the "News" page in the software (which had an error message and un blue background on some computers)
Due to some DLL modifications, the size will increase by 150mo

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Due to the discord demand, 36 new assets added
You can now add Headsets to your face emotes and your 3/4 emotes

We invite you to join our discord channel to give us many more ideas
The next update will be a new DLC for halloween

notes.title: BETA UPDATE 02
notes.notes:
New feature: buttons added to change color, contrast, etc. The effect is applied when the button is unpressed.

Import bug fixed: When importing an emote, the layers remained empty. It is now fixed but previous exports will no longer work (bug that only appeared in French)
